added.summary: On og-ui's new core, a style takes border (and its sides, width and colour, which take layout space), per-corner border-radius, box-shadow (up to four layers, inset or not), outline and outline-offset, translate, scale, rotate, transform-origin, backdrop-filter: blur(), text-shadow and text-decoration, and a linear-gradient's to-corner direction. The paint pass does not draw them yet.
